$Comment: The chain's last rung, and the one that pays the Greater Disenchanting Table: bring Orrin the
makings and he builds the wider table around the frame he keeps.
The three deliveries are the thorium, the silk and the Void essence the greater table's own
recipe asks for, less the lesser table it consumes (the player keeps theirs; Orrin has a frame
of his own) and with the essence count brought down, since a player who has only just learned
to find void has no stock of it. All three sit on Order 1 and hand in to Orrin only
(TurnInNpcId 'giver'), so they can be brought in any order. The reward sits in the Claim
bucket, so the table and the XP wait in the quest log until the player collects them.
With this pack installed the greater table is never crafted (the pack ships the block with no
Recipe), so this quest is the only place one comes from. Claiming it also opens Loose Threads,
the short order whose tables pay the disenchanter's kit, and the Voidheart rung of Orrin's own
chain. Completing it is what the Disenchanting Master achievement counts, so a retune here
changes what that achievement asks. Remove the Item entry and the chain ends on a plain XP
job; the table itself is what this quest is for.
Name: The_Greater_Table
